messages:
ravi: Heads-up — we're about to onboard the 70B-open quantized builds to Dedicated. Quick question: what safety buffer do we want for autoscale headroom across regions given the h100/a100 hetero pools? p99 SLO is 450ms for chat workloads.

sam: Good call. From last week's bench: h100 (q4f16) p50 ~ 45ms, p99 ~ 140ms; a100 (q4f16) p50 ~ 85ms, p99 ~ 260ms. So baseline headroom depends a lot on kernel mix and q-profile.

maria: Also remember EU region saw ~15% higher tail vs us-west during the 2pm surge test — likely network + infra placement. Need region-specific margins.

kevin: My suggestion: set target concurrency per-GPU so we don't overcommit. For 70B q4f16 on h100 aim 6-8 concurrent inference slots; on a100 3-4. That maps to safer p99 headroom estimates.

ravi: That sounds reasonable. Ops ask: how many reserved GPUs per pool for burst? Right now we have autoscale max = desired + 20%. Is 20% enough?

sam: 20% was fine for uniform workloads but with hetero mix and higher p99 on a100 we saw degradation once concurrency spiked. I'd bump to 30% for Dedicated burst pools for first 2 weeks of onboarding, then re-evaluate with metrics.

maria: +1 for 30%. Also enable model-variant fallback to smaller quant (q8_0) for the lowest tier customers to reduce pressure. Add canary route to test fallback.

kevin: Practical config snippet I used for sim runs — we can start from this and adjust numbers:

```yaml
pool:
  name: 70b-dedicated-hetero
  gpus:
    - type: h100
      min: 4
      desired: 12
      max: 20
    - type: a100
      min: 2
      desired: 6
      max: 12
  concurrency_per_gpu:
    h100: 7
    a100: 3
  autoscale:
    headroom_pct: 30
    cooldown_sec: 300
    scale_step: 2
```

kevin: That config assumes the 30% headroom and aims to keep queueing low. Run the synthetic burst sim with 1.5x expected daily peak and check p99 and token backlog.

ravi: I'll schedule the sim. One more: kernel fallback — should we prefer the Triton-optimized kernel for h100s and cuBLAS path for a100? Any perf deltas to be aware of?

sam: Triton kernels give ~10-20% token throughput win on h100 with our fused attention path, but on a100 the cuBLAS path is more stable for q4f16 right now. We should mark kernel_tiers in the pool metadata and allow runtime routing.

maria: Action items: (1) ravi to run sim per-region with the YAML above and attach p50/p99 + concurrency. (2) kevin to add kernel_tiers flag and fallback policy. (3) sam to craft short runbook for 30% temporary headroom and rollback criteria. I'll create a ticket.

ops-bot: deploybot: canary job queued: simulate/70b-dedicated-hetero/us-west at 2024-11-08T18:00Z — notify #eng-platform on completion. :satellite:

ravi: Thanks — I'll post results in this thread. If we see p99 > 450ms with headroom 30% we will pause onboarding and run tuned quant + kernel experiments.

sam: Also log these in the capacity dashboard (per-pool slices) so SRE can watch autoscale thrash.

maria: And add a short eval: generation quality delta between q4f16 vs q8_0 on 50 canonical prompts — to ensure no surprising regressions when fallback fires.

kevin: All set. I'll push kernel flags and the canary routes.

ravi: great, thanks everyone.
